agent_sessions_closer_idx.name: agent_sessions_closer_idx
agent_sessions_closer_idx.where: "agent_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_sessions"."triage_status" <> 'overflowed' AND ("agent_sessions"."triage_status" <> 'completed' OR "agent_sessions"."needs_look")

oauth_clients_secret_consistency_check.name: oauth_clients_secret_consistency_check
oauth_clients_secret_consistency_check.value:
("oauth_clients"."token_endpoint_auth_method" = 'none' AND "oauth_clients"."client_secret_hash" IS NULL)
        OR ("oauth_clients"."token_endpoint_auth_method" <> 'none' AND "oauth_clients"."client_secret_hash" IS NOT NULL)

user_retrieval_policy_scope_consistency_.name: user_retrieval_policy_scope_consistency_check
user_retrieval_policy_scope_consistency_.value: (("user_retrieval_policy"."mode" = 'off' AND "user_retrieval_policy"."default_scope" IS NULL) OR ("user_retrieval_policy"."mode" = 'default' AND "user_retrieval_policy"."default_scope" IS NOT NULL) OR ("user_retrieval_policy"."mode" = 'require' AND "user_retrieval_policy"."default_scope" IS NULL))

fact_proposals_validity_check.name: fact_proposals_validity_check
fact_proposals_validity_check.value: "fact_proposals"."valid_to" IS NULL OR ("fact_proposals"."valid_from" IS NOT NULL AND "fact_proposals"."valid_from" <= "fact_proposals"."valid_to")

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') IS NULL OR user_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
tenant_isolation.withCheck: NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') IS NULL OR user_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
